definitions.gloss: inefficiency; being inefficient; lack of efficiency
definitions.explanation: The state of not being efficient — wasting time, effort, or resources. Used as a noun and as a な-adjective (非効率な).

examples.japanese: {非効率|ひこうりつ}な{作業|さぎょう}を{改善|かいぜん}する。
この{方法|ほうほう}は{非効率|ひこうりつ}だと{思|おも}う。
examples.english: I think this method is inefficient.

examples.japanese: {会議|かいぎ}が{長引|ながび}くのは{非効率|ひこうりつ}の{典型的|てんけいてき}な{例|れい}だ。
examples.english: Meetings dragging on is a typical example of inefficiency.

notes:
Composed of {非|ひ} (non-, un-) + {効率|こうりつ} (efficiency). The prefix {非|ひ} negates the base word. Functions as both a noun and a な-adjective ({非効率|ひこうりつ}な).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {非効率|ひこうりつ}な{作業|さぎょう}: inefficient work
- {非効率|ひこうりつ}な{運営|うんえい}: inefficient management
- {非効率|ひこうりつ}を{排除|はいじょ}する: to eliminate inefficiency
- {非効率|ひこうりつ}な{組織|そしき}: an inefficient organization

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {効率|こうりつ}が{悪|わる}い: low efficiency (more colloquial way to say the same thing)
- {無駄|むだ}: waste, futility (focuses on the wasted effort/resources rather than the process)
- {非生産的|ひせいさんてき}: unproductive (focuses on output rather than process efficiency)
